# mark text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:markText`](gmeow-markText.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/markText>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The textual form of a mark (the brand name / word mark), e.g. "Blackcat Informatics®".

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:markText`](gmeow-markText.md) from [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the word-mark / brand-name string of a [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching it to the [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) right (it belongs on the [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md)) and avoid using it for the registration number, which is [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](gmeow-registrationNumber.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:markText`](gmeow-markText.md) once per [`Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md) (functional) to its textual brand form; a purely figurative mark may carry an image reference on the [`Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md) instead.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatMark [`gmeow:markText`](gmeow-markText.md) "Blackcat Informatics®".
